name: anvesh
description: ANVESH — predictive analytics and cybercrime interdiction framework (SIH 26184). Synthetic demo only.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @anvesh/api" "npm run dev -w @anvesh/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,engine -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @anvesh/api" "npm run dev -w @anvesh/web" "npm run engine:start"
scripts.engine:start: cd apps/python-engine && (.\venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload || python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload)
scripts.build: npm run build -w @anvesh/api && npm run build -w @anvesh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @anvesh/shared && npm run typecheck -w @anvesh/api && npm run typecheck -w @anvesh/web
